snippet.title: The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu | Gameplay Showcase
snippet.description:
Join Art Director Edmundo Bordeu for a tense gameplay showcase of The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu.

Witness the living jungle come alive to deceive you, feel your sanity fray with every step, and get a terrifying glimpse of the monsters that hunt you and your team. Learn what it takes to collect loot, face the madness, and ultimately flee for your survival.

The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu launches July 15th for PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC. Wishlist now.
